nom: florence by mills Clear Canvas Milky Oil Cleansing Balm

avis.texte: I love this cleansing balm! It's the only makeup remover that does not get into my eyes and cause everything to look blurry for the next half hour. It works really well in combination with a microfiber cloth and removes all of my mascara and eyeliner. It has a nice herbal scent that washes away with the product, so you only smell it while using it (which I prefer since I have slightly sensitive skin). Overall this is a nice solid first step in a double cleanse.

I love a lot of Florence products and bought this hoping to be able to skip a step in my routine. I don't have a problem with the packaging, I think being able to squeeze it on your hands or cotton pad is convenient and had no issues. My main issue is that the product is SO greasy! It makes my face feel oily instantly and it does not wash off easily. You are left with a thick, oily residue on your face and you are just wiping around your makeup or sunscreen making it worse and harder to remove from the eyes and other areas. I have to use several cotton pads/squares and then add in some micellar water and it takes way too long to remove. So definitely did not save on time and actually added a step. If using in the shower maybe it would be easier, but that's not what I was looking for. Clean-it and other products offer the same results without that heavy greasy feeling like vasoline on your face. I would not recommend.
Love the feel and the way this cleanser smells. Gentle on skin and dissolves makeup easily! Definitely will buy this face wash again.

avis.titre: HELLO Clear Canvas, GOODBYE makeup wipes & drying cleansers
avis.texte: Hate how makeup remover leaves an oily film on your skin? Hate how cleanser dries you out? Never fear, as this product will replace your makeup remover & be your new best cleanser in one, leaving you with silky smooth, blurred, slightly glassy skin. The Product: smells bright, maybe slightly cirtusy. Goes on smooth, turns to oil (think the way clear pore erasing primer feels), and then as you wash becomes an easily removable foam. Easy, no mess screw open/closed reseal packaging. As a sensitive skin girlie, I'm wary any time I try a new product on my face. This product from flo by millie proved I had not only nothing to fear, but became a new staple in my routine. Whether I'm removing makeup from a long day out or washing my face in the morning, this gentle cleanser leaves me refreshed, my skin cleansed & replenished, & excited to use again! This product removes makeup effortlessly—yes even stubborn mascara!!—due to including Marula Oil. It doesn't dry out your skin, instead replenishes it with Ceramides, and nourishing Vitamin E.
